input: Compare travel insurance plans for Southeast Asia

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Southeast Asia spans many countries — knowing exactly which countries are included changes which plans are eligible and what coverage is needed (e.g., some plans exclude certain countries).
Whether this is for a solo traveler, a couple, a family, or a group affects which plan types are available and how cost comparisons should be structured.
Trip duration and dates determine whether a single-trip or annual multi-trip plan makes more sense, and affect pricing significantly.
A budget ceiling for the insurance premium itself narrows the field of options and shapes the trade-off between coverage depth and cost.
Planned activities (e.g., scuba diving, motorbiking, trekking) heavily influence which coverage riders or plan tiers are necessary, as many standard plans exclude adventure sports.
Knowing which coverage category matters most — medical evacuation, trip cancellation, gear theft, etc. — determines what to prioritize when scoring and ranking plans.
Whether the user wants a side-by-side comparison table, a ranked shortlist, or a full written report shapes how the output should be structured and delivered.

gold.taskTitle: Compare travel insurance plans for Southeast Asia
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate travel insurance options suitable for a trip to Southeast Asia.

questions.title: Which specific countries will you be visiting?
questions.description: Identify the exact Southeast Asian countries on the itinerary to ensure plan eligibility and regional coverage are accurate.

questions.title: How many people need to be covered?
questions.description: Determine whether the insurance is for a solo traveler, couple, family, or group to identify the right plan category.

questions.title: How long is the trip and when does it start?
questions.description: Establish trip duration and departure date to evaluate single-trip vs. annual plans and get accurate pricing.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for the insurance premium?
questions.description: Set a spending ceiling for the policy cost so comparisons stay within realistic options.

questions.title: What activities do you plan to do on the trip?
questions.description: Identify high-risk activities like motorbiking, scuba diving, or trekking that may require special riders or higher-tier plans.

questions.title: Which type of coverage matters most to you?
questions.description: Pinpoint the user's top priority — such as emergency medical, trip cancellation, baggage theft, or evacuation — to weight the comparison accordingly.

questions.title: What format do you want the final comparison in?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a comparison table, a ranked shortlist with pros/cons, or a detailed written breakdown.
